aqua_builder.description: Spawn a Builder specialist to create, fix, or improve WASM components (catalysts, reagents, formulas). Handles Rust/WASM development, WIT interfaces, compilation, manifest work. NOT for tinctures — use aqua_artisan or aqua_arcade.
aqua_builder.title: Builder

aqua_artisan.description: Spawn an Artisan specialist to create, fix, or improve tincture apps and dashboards. Handles frontends for data displays, viewers, readers, tools. Chooses vanilla or React based on complexity. NOT for games or 3D — use aqua_arcade.
aqua_artisan.title: Artisan

aqua_arcade.description: Spawn an Arcade specialist to create, fix, or improve game tinctures and 3D visualizations. Knows Canvas 2D for simple games and picks the best-fit library (Three.js, Babylon.js, Pixi.js, Phaser, etc.) for complex games. Handles game loops, physics, input, particles.
aqua_arcade.title: Arcade

aqua_explorer.description: Spawn an Explorer specialist for deep web research. Use for fact-finding requiring multiple searches, documentation lookup, external research. Returns synthesized findings.
aqua_explorer.title: Explorer

aqua_planner.description: Spawn a Planner specialist for analysis and planning. Read-only research agent.
aqua_planner.title: Planner

aqua_web.description: Spawn a Web specialist for direct HTTP interactions. Reads pages as Markdown, sends webhooks/POST requests, discovers links, extracts metadata. Uses the local HTTP catalyst — works with any URL including localhost and internal services.
aqua_web.title: Web
